problems.description: Employees receive emails impersonating executives requesting urgent wire transfers or sensitive data, leveraging social engineering to bypass normal verification.
risk_reduction: Implement email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Train employees to verify unusual requests through separate communication channels
Use advanced email filtering solutions to detect spoofed senders

problems.description: Spear-phishing campaigns target specific departments with tailored messages containing malicious attachments that deploy ransomware upon opening.
risk_reduction: Conduct targeted phishing awareness training for high-risk teams
Deploy endpoint protection with behavior-based malware detection
Restrict execution of macros and scripts in email attachments

problems.description: Credential harvesting sites mimic corporate login portals, tricking employees into submitting usernames and passwords that attackers then use for unauthorized access.
risk_reduction: Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all systems
Use browser security tools to warn users about fraudulent sites
Regularly update and communicate official login URLs and security policies

problems.description: Attackers send phishing emails to cloud administrators with links to fake cloud console login pages, aiming to steal credentials and gain control over cloud resources.
risk_reduction: Enforce MFA for all cloud management accounts
Implement conditional access policies restricting login locations
Educate cloud admins on recognizing phishing attempts and verifying URLs

problems.description: Phishing campaigns target developers by sending fake notifications about compromised repositories, prompting them to enter credentials on malicious sites.
risk_reduction: Use single sign-on (SSO) with MFA for developer tools
Monitor and alert on unusual login attempts or IP addresses
Train developers on secure handling of repository notifications

problems.description: Phishing emails impersonate cloud service providers with fake billing alerts, tricking users into clicking links that install malware or steal credentials.
risk_reduction: Verify billing communications through official provider portals
Deploy email security gateways with phishing detection
Conduct regular phishing simulation exercises for cloud users

problems.description: Individuals receive SMS or email messages pretending to be from banks or popular services, urging them to click links and enter personal information on fraudulent websites.
risk_reduction: Avoid clicking links in unsolicited messages; access services directly
Use mobile security apps that detect phishing URLs
Enable MFA on personal accounts to reduce impact of credential theft

problems.description: Phishing attacks via social media direct messages lure users to fake login pages or malicious downloads, compromising personal data and devices.
risk_reduction: Be cautious of unsolicited messages and friend requests
Keep social media privacy settings restrictive
Use antivirus and anti-phishing browser extensions

problems.description: Voice phishing (vishing) calls impersonate trusted entities requesting sensitive information or payment details, exploiting trust and urgency.
risk_reduction: Verify caller identity independently before sharing information
Register with call-blocking services and report suspicious calls
Educate family members about common vishing tactics

problems.description: Attackers infiltrate trusted third-party vendors or software providers to insert malicious code or backdoors, compromising enterprise environments indirectly.
risk_reduction: Implement strict vendor risk management and security assessments
Use software bill of materials (SBOM) to track dependencies
Monitor for anomalous behavior in supply chain software updates

problems.description: Cloud storage services (e.g., S3 buckets) are misconfigured with overly permissive access controls, exposing sensitive data to unauthorized parties.
risk_reduction: Enforce least privilege access policies
Continuously audit cloud storage configurations
Use automated tools to detect and remediate misconfigurations

problems.description: Attackers manipulate input data to machine learning models causing misclassification or evasion, undermining AI-based security controls or business processes.
risk_reduction: Implement robust ML model validation and anomaly detection
Use adversarial training techniques to harden models
Monitor model inputs and outputs for suspicious patterns

problems.description: Phishing campaigns leveraging AI-generated content (text, voice deepfakes) to create highly convincing and scalable social engineering attacks.
risk_reduction: Deploy AI-based detection tools for synthetic content
Enhance user training to recognize AI-generated deception
Implement multi-factor authentication to reduce credential theft impact

problems.description: Ransomware operations offered as a service lower the barrier for attackers, increasing ransomware incidents with sophisticated extortion tactics.
risk_reduction: Maintain regular, tested backups with offline copies
Apply timely patching and vulnerability management
Use network segmentation and endpoint detection and response (EDR)
